resolvedFinding.mechanism: The original root identity omitted global pause/speed and unit attack pause. A newer keyboard or actual unit pause during a held touch could be reversed by the old release.

coverage: Actual main identity, constructor, capture listeners, delegated dispatcher and game subscriber execute with real Game state
Touch/pen starts exactly one actual wave without click
Actual renderSidebar replaces a wall button during the press; unchanged release demolishes once
App capture suppression stops a retargeted click before a canvas trap can place in the next real draft
Changed selected wall and replaced Game identity reject stale releases
Actual global keydown leaves focused-button Space to exactly one keyboard/AT native click
Actual scroll/wheel/blur/hidden-document listeners cancel pending commands
Actual startGame clears pending command input before unrelated asset/session construction
Window capture observes an external touch even when the target stops propagation
Held global Pause/Speed and held unit Pause cannot reverse a newer state

cssReview.baselineMechanism: Topbar z-index 5 trapped its menu below sidebar z-index 8; expanded map overview z-index 9 and low-landscape viewport-wide grid could overlap sidebar controls through pointer-events:auto aside children.
cssReview.v31SourceFix: Last-imported topbar20/sidebar11/footer12 and map-width overview constraints put primary controls above optional map panels.

boundaries: Only the new integration test and its evidence were written by this agent; root owns all main/CSS changes.
Event surfaces model capture/target/bubble and stopImmediatePropagation; they do not render CSS or certify a physical iPad/Safari.
Real source renderSidebar/towerPanel create the wall markup; persistence, audio playback and unrelated crafting stamping are bounded fixture stubs.
The full actual startGame declaration is executed only until an audio.resetRun fixture sentinel, proving input clear occurs first without constructing assets/sessions.
Main/CSS hashes describe the reviewed snapshot, not ownership or a freeze of root files.
